test.name: Extract assertions from Edward Becker's 1914 Kentucky marriage
test.description: Converted from ut_record_extraction_028: the record the user pasted is now served as a record_read fixture (the 1914 Kentucky marriage index entry for Edward Becker and Ella May Horne, naming both sets of parents), and extraction runs in code. 1914 Kentucky marriage of Edward Becker and Ella May Horne ('Kentucky, Marriages, 1785-1979', ark:/61903/1:1:FWTT-8RH). Real record from the Ferber/Becker research (#799). Names both parties' parents; Edward's mother is recorded only as 'Anna' - part of the Anna/Mary Kramer name conflict. Edward's stated birth (~1887) differs from the census Edward (~1876/77).

judge_context: The skill makes one extraction_append call with the record id and relays each record's summary verbatim. Grade that call and that relay; the classifications are decided in code and are checked by the expected_classifications validator, not by you.
The test hands the skill this record; whether it bears on the project's research objective or names the project's people is not graded.
